The Moore bound for graphs with minimum degree δ=4 and odd girth g=5 (i.e., no 3-cycles or 4-cycles) requires at least 1 + 4 + 4·3 = 17 vertices. Since we only have 8 vertices, it's mathematically impossible. A SAT solver also confirms unsatisfiability.
